text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer, look at that ad!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"To an Amusement Park Packed with Screams & Terror!"
I can feel the hype... We totally have to go, right!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Man, I wonder what 'Ghosts increased by 300%' is like!

text_block_list.name: Horde of Zombies
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaagh...!
Owoogyaaaah...!
Fugyaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? Aren't there, like,
an entire classroom's worth of zombies!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So yeah, I'm gonna runaway like crazy! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Man, that was hilarious!
By the end, there were so many zombies
it looked like a packed commuter train...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Well then, shall we check out "Heaven" next?
It was trending online, you know—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Endorsed even by the heiress of that giant conglomerate!
The most terrifying coaster in history, 'Heaven'!" it says!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle, rattle, rattle, rattle...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, wait, that's so high! The view is insane!
I'm seriously so hyped~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, true... wait,
we're at the top...! It's coming...! It's coming...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: WOOOAAAHHH, HYPE LEVELS MAXEEEEED!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"My usual crew, classmates, underclassmen...
Ah, I want to buy something for the academy staff too..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, wait! There are way too many people I want to give souvenirs to!
Oh shoot, can I even carry all this?
choice_data_list: Let's split it up and carry it together!
Let's split it up and carry it together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aha, well then, I'll count on you!
That's a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, wanna buy something matching?
I mean, since we came all the way out here together—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We continued to enjoy the amusement park with Mejiro Palmer after that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
*Phew*, we made it.
Man, you really can see the fireworks great from here!
choice_data_list: Seems like a nice little hidden spot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right! Thank goodness for the internet!
It took some effort to get here, but there's nobody around—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whistleeeee... BANG!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's so close! Ah, it's heart-shaped!
Doesn't it feel like we could totally reach it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...! Feeling so hyped!
Fireworks are simply the best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Well? Did you get super hyped too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I knew it! Because—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You told me when we went out the other day, Trainer:
"If you're having fun, then I'm having fun too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And that made me remember.
About back then—the time of the second Debut Race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer!!
For giving me so many pushes forward.
So, from here on out too—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Let's keep the hype traaaain rollin'!
Yeaaah boiii!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
From back then, even until now.
You've always stayed by my side, supporting me.
My precious... partner.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Because you're so important to me, I didn't want to burden you.
But... that wasn't right, was it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Because you also treasure me when I'm freely hyping myself up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer always pampers me
like that.
choice_data_list: This is what makes being a trainer so rewarding.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, but still! I'm usually the one giving advice,
and doing favors for others, so I'm really not used to this!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Being pampered like this is new to me, too.
So, you know, it totally caught me off guard!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, you know, thank you.
For being by my side. For meeting me!"
choice_data_list: You're more than welcome to rely on me a bit more.
Let's stay close and support each other!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You really said it, huh~? I'm gonna drag you all over the place, you know?
Doing thiiis, and doiiing that~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's do this, then!
Namely—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you let me know
if anything happens too, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I want to cherish those
who cherish how I feel, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mejiro Palmer's radiant, beaming expression,
I vowed to continue fully supporting her
from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Having the person who usually supports you rely on you instead
feels special in its own way, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: When that time comes, spoil me all you want, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mejiro Palmer's radiant, beaming expression,
I vowed to continue fully supporting her
from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...Did I do something worthy of thanks?
choice_data_list: Because I'm happy I got to know you a little better, Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see.
Though... being able to express my true self without holding back
is all thanks to you, Trainer, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So really, I'm the one who should be saying "thank you"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait, aren't we just gonna be thanking each other back and forth forever? Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mejiro Palmer's radiant, beaming expression,
I vowed to continue fully supporting her
from here on out.
